alert: During the busiest hour, requests for order history slowed to a crawl, then the app started failing to save anything because it could not get a database connection.

source.title: GitHub, An update on recent service disruptions (2022-03-16 incident)
source.notes: Same pattern: a poorly performing query at peak load exhausted database proxy connections and writes failed; fixed by adding an index. Lab: an index is dropped and peak traffic arrives on new connections.
